fragments.text: Our AI-powered Advantage+ end-to-end solutions continued to grow, reaching over $75 billion in annual revenue run-rate this quarter.
We’re also leveraging AI to empower businesses to more easily manage their campaigns, develop ad creative, and engage with their customers.

items.comment: Stated for Q2 2026; figure is 'over $75 billion'.

fragments.text: Yesterday, as part of our Meta Compute effort, we announced a new strategic venture with BlackRock to develop a new 1GW data center in El Paso, Texas.

new_facts.why_it_matters: New partnership structure adds external capital to AI data-center buildout.

fragments.text: We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $130-145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $125-145 billion.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Capex guidance range indicates scale of AI infrastructure investment.

fragments.text: Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $31.1 billion, driven by investments in servers, data centers, and network infrastructure.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Quarterly capex reflects ongoing AI infrastructure spend.

fragments.text: We ended the quarter with $90.3 billion in cash and marketable securities and $83.7 billion in debt.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Balance sheet capacity and debt mix support infrastructure funding.

fragments.text: Finally, we believe that overall industry capacity is going to remain tight for the foreseeable future.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Industry capacity tightness supports demand for compute and infrastructure investment.
